svg.title: Two studies: reported tensile strength and temperature
svg.desc: Ten condition summaries from two different experiments. Read the protocol and statistic differences before the values. Interpretation limits Descriptive juxtaposition only. Matched conditions and statistical independence are not established. Common units, PA12/15 wt.% declarations and ±45° labels do not make the formulations, protocols or central statistics equivalent. These are different commercial formulations. Declared PA12 and 15 wt.% carbon fiber are not an independent composition assay. A 100% infill setting does not establish measured zero porosity. Drying does not establish measured specimen moisture. Actual moisture/RH, stress convention, stress-area basis and local strain rate remain unestablished. Source-cited standards are not verified compliance; nominal dimensions do not establish actual stress area. Unknown conditions are not treated as equal. Temperature is a reported chamber condition, not a directly verified specimen reading; its uncertainty is unknown. 23 °C is not 25 °C. Even the shared 100 °C label does not establish matched conditioning. No rate ratio or merged condition row is inferred. SD is reported dispersion, not SEM, CI, uncertainty of a median, an observed endpoint range, coverage, a hard bound or a complete uncertainty budget. Raw replicates, their independence and the SD formula are unverified; counts do not justify calculating a CI. No interpolation, extrapolation, fit, pooling, normalization, deltas, ranking, significance, material prediction, design allowable or geometry-derived conversion. Agreement between transcriptions is not experimental replication or scientific validation. Scientific wording, the new presentation and translations are machine-assisted and not independently scientifically or native-language reviewed. Transcription agreement verifies copying only. Source-specific protocols, before any property values Product and preparation Ciganas et al. (2026): Fiberlogy PA12 CF15; horizontal FFF, alternating +45°/−45°; drying 80 °C for 12 h; postprint annealing unreported. Zach and Dudescu (2025): Bambu Lab PAHT-CF; flat FFF, ±45°; predrying and selected annealing each 80 °C for 12 h. Natural-convection cooling to room temperature in a vacuum-sealed dehumidified container; cooling rate unknown. Preparation wording is ambiguous. Printing Ciganas et al. (2026): Creality K1 MAX; 0.6 mm nozzle; 265 °C extrusion. Zach and Dudescu (2025): Bambu Lab X1 Carbon; 0.4 mm nozzle; 290 °C extrusion. Test and geometry Ciganas et al. (2026): Step-Lab UD08. Nominal dimensions: length 150 mm, thickness 3 mm, narrow/wide width 10/20 mm. Gauge 80 mm differs from the 110 mm grip/strain reference, which includes transition regions. Zach and Dudescu (2025): Instron 5967. Drawing annotations only; caption unit not established. Narrow width, actual stress area, gauge length and grip separation unknown; straight-section length is not assumed to be gauge length. Reported displacement rate Ciganas et al. (2026): 1 mm/min displacement/crosshead rate; not measured local strain rate. Zach and Dudescu (2025): 10 mm/s reported displacement rate, as printed; control channel unknown. No silent correction to mm/min. Central statistic and count Ciganas et al. (2026): Central statistic and aggregation unnamed; three tensile tests per temperature condition. Zach and Dudescu (2025): Reported median; five specimens per orientation × temperature × annealing group. SD evidence Ciganas et al. (2026): Table 3 UTS row prints MPa ± SD. The reported SD unit is MPa. Zach and Dudescu (2025): Separate SD column has no printed unit. MPa is inferred from the UTS context; SD-to-Pa scaling is conditional on that inference. Temperature conditions Ciganas et al. (2026): Six reported chamber conditions; 30 min stabilization. Direct specimen temperature and temperature uncertainty unreported. Zach and Dudescu (2025): Four reported chamber conditions; 30 min conditioning. Direct specimen temperature and temperature uncertainty unestablished. Dots show reported central summaries only. Reported SD is listed separately below; no uncertainty endpoints are drawn. Missing temperature whiskers mean uncertainty was not reported, not zero. Both panels use 15–155 °C and 0–65 MPa display axes. These are padding, not validated ranges or material limits. Tick marks are references, not observations; exact tested conditions are in each table. Source strings and trailing zeros are preserved. Printed digits do not establish resolution or accuracy. The two studies remain separate tables. Ciganas et al. (2026) Fiberlogy PA12 CF15 · horizontal FFF · annealing unreported n=3 tensile tests per temperature condition; independence unverified SD in MPa, explicit in the Table 3 UTS ± SD row Reported central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified Exact values and separate reported SD Chamber (°C): 23; Central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified: 49.07; Reported SD (MPa): 0.88 Chamber (°C): 40; Central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified: 40.31; Reported SD (MPa): 0.72 Chamber (°C): 60; Central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified: 32.70; Reported SD (MPa): 1.18 Chamber (°C): 80; Central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified: 26.60; Reported SD (MPa): 1.15 Chamber (°C): 100; Central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified: 22.78; Reported SD (MPa): 0.97 Chamber (°C): 120; Central UTS (MPa); statistic unspecified: 18.68; Reported SD (MPa): 0.91 Zach and Dudescu (2025) Bambu Lab PAHT-CF · flat FFF · annealed ±45° group n=5 specimens per orientation × temperature × annealing group; independence unverified SD unit MPa inferred from UTS context; not printed in the SD header Reported median UTS (MPa) Exact values and separate reported SD Chamber (°C): 25; Median UTS (MPa): 58.91; SD (MPa inferred from UTS context): 3.44 Chamber (°C): 50; Median UTS (MPa): 40.87; SD (MPa inferred from UTS context): 4.59 Chamber (°C): 100; Median UTS (MPa): 29.64; SD (MPa inferred from UTS context): 0.72 Chamber (°C): 150; Median UTS (MPa): 19.03; SD (MPa inferred from UTS context): 0.67 Sources, locators, revisions and rights Ciganas et al. Effect of Annealing on High Temperature Tensile Performance of 3D Printed Polyamide Carbon Fiber: A Comparative Study. Journal of Composites Science 9(11), 624. DOI: 10.3390/jcs9110624 Appendix A, Table A1; annealed ±45° rows; temperature blocks 25, 50, 100, 150 °C; “σUTS [MPa]” and “Standard Deviation” columns. Median: Section 3.1. Table / expanded-table locator: jcs-09-00624-t0A1 / table_body_display_jcs-09-00624-t0A1 HTML inspected: 2026-10-03; reported HTML update: 2 September 2026 03:21 CEST Search-rendered discussion arrangement differed; no selected-cell discrepancy found. Section 2.2 describes annealing for all specimens, while Table A1/Section 2.3 distinguish groups: only explicitly annealed rows are selected. Possible prior-study non-annealed overlap was not audited; independence is not established. CC BY 4.0 Publisher PDFs were not inspected; pagination and HTML/PDF equivalence are unestablished. Revision descriptors are not immutable source hashes. CC BY 4.0 adaptation: selected factual strings preserved and reorganized into separate central-value plots and SD tables; curator notes added. This separately curated named descriptive presentation does not change scientific admission or review status. Exact SI re-expression remains metadata; Zach SD scaling is conditional. No source PDFs, figures, screenshots, HTML dumps, raw data or supplier assets are redistributed. MIT covers original project contributions only; no author or publisher endorsement is implied. Full source/record snapshots, original notation, nulls, evidence, exact SI metadata and catalog-metadata digests are retained in HTML audit details and JSON/CSV exports. Digests do not identify publisher artifact bytes.

Temperature is a reported chamber condition, not a directly verified specimen reading; its uncertainty is unknown. 23 °C is not 25 °C. Even
the shared 100 °C label does not establish matched conditioning. No rate ratio or merged condition row is inferred.
SD is reported dispersion, not SEM, CI, uncertainty of a median, an observed endpoint range, coverage, a hard bound or a complete uncertainty
